q: Does a cool roof coating cut energy use and emissions in a factory?
title: Cool roof coating: energy effect
short: In air-conditioned spaces, a reflective roof coating reduces heat entering through the roof, so cooling uses fewer kWh. In sheds without cooling it improves comfort but saves little electricity. Measure cooling kWh in comparable months before and after, then multiply the saving by 0.710.
audience: Factory, warehouse and cold store owners

ul: Thin metal roofs over air-conditioned or chilled areas.
Coatings lose reflectance as they get dirty; plan cleaning.
Insulation may beat coating where the roof is uninsulated.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel invoices and electricity bills and applies IPCC 2006 factors and the CEA grid factor (0.710 kg CO2 per kWh), so you can compare Scope 1 and 2 before and after a change from the documents themselves.

sources.label: CEA CO2 Baseline Database for the Indian Power Sector
